#!name=朴朴超市去广告
#!desc=Surge 模块 · 来源 Surge
#!author=ClashModule

[MITM]
hostname = j1.pupuapi.com

[Rewrite]
^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/account\/discount\/order - reject
^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/marketing\/banner\/v7\?position_types=100 - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/marketing\/banner\/v7, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/marketing\/banner\/search_component_banner, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/search\/hot_keywords\/v3, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/app_resource\/resource_preload\/list_h5_resource, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/recommendation\/interests\/products, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/j1\.pupuapi\.com\/client\/marketing\/advertisement\/v1, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PuPuMall/PuPuMall_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
